comparative.text: [The Vegetable Kingdom] Alstonia, so far as proved, causes debility, low fever, often with diarrhoea, and, when pushed, rigors, sweat, etc., purging, cramps and vertigo. Clinically, it has been used in chills and fever, in diarrhoea of malarial origin, here vieing with China, and for chronic intermit- tent fevers suppressed by quinine.
